mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_relation (platform, bot_id, group_id, user_id_a, user_id_b, relation_kind, strength) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{userIdA}, #{userIdB}, #{relationKind}, GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, #{strength}))) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE relation_kind = VALUES (relation_kind), strength = GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, strength + #{strength}))
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, user_id_a AS userIdA, user_id_b AS userIdB, relation_kind AS relationKind, strength, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM member_relation WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY id
